title: Cost accounting for shared-tier deployments
description: The shared tier has one papyrus role, so one usage queue (product papyrus) carries many deployments: the ledger must check that a message's deployment exists and belongs to its Account instead of deriving the product from papyrus-<site>. Shared-tier resources are tagged anthus:account=shared and split by per-deployment usage. Coordinate with kanbus-bb0b6c.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan, 2026-11-09: the design partner's three new sites launch directly on the shared tier at Papyrus M7, never as dedicated sites. This is required for the partner launch at M7, not a later migration. Priority raised to 1.
